world.name: Tropical South Indian wedding mantap complex — maze
world.continuity_style: pastel tropical elegance; cream carved stone; jasmine+lotus; banana/palm; brass lamps; soft warm morning light; cinematic storybook 9:16
world.same_place_rule: All six beats ONE venue. Each shot a DISTINCT room (A–F). No vista reuse.

far_vista_lock.hero_plate: misty lake + temple gopuram + mountains + wooden boat
far_vista_lock.rule: FORBIDDEN as dominant background on every beat.

facets.palm_approach_garden: Room A — outdoor palm approach garden; tropical path; orange flowers; looking toward colonnade courtyard
facets.central_colonnade_courtyard: Room B — central courtyard with fountain; cream colonnades; potted palms; hub connecting A/C/E
facets.east_floral_arcade: Room C — east floral arcade aisle; pillars; hanging floral garlands; leads toward stair cascade
facets.stair_cascade_court: Room F — stair cascade court; grand stairs with tiered water features / tropical flanks; adjacent to stage E and arcade C
facets.ceremony_stage_mandap: Room E — ceremony mandap stage; floral pillars; couple STANDING; adjacent to stairs F, courtyard B, pond D
facets.lotus_pond_photoshoot_terrace: Room D — lotus pond photoshoot terrace; rectangular lotus pond; invite text; couple STANDING; adjacent to A and E

wardrobe_lock.applies_when: couple visible (scene-05, scene-06 / rooms E, D)
wardrobe_lock.groom: maroon half-sleeve shirt + white gold-border veshti + sandals
wardrobe_lock.bride: rich green silk bridal saree; heavy gold jewellery; long bridal hair with jasmine+roses — NOT a bun
wardrobe_lock.pose: Couple STANDING still, holding hands, looking at each other. Feet planted.

maze_logic: Every hop = one adjacent graph edge only (L/R/FWD/pivot-pull). Hamiltonian path — no room reuse. No teleport.
